# atlassian_data_security_policy (Resource)

Manages an unpublished Atlassian data-security policy draft through the Admin Control API.

> **Supported scope**
> Only the verified `ORG`-level `export` rule is supported. Publishing and resource associations are not managed.

> **Deprecated API**
> Atlassian marks the underlying public policy operations deprecated and may temporarily disable them. No public replacement is currently documented.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atlassian_data_security_policy" "example" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"

  data = {
    type = "policy"
    attributes = {
      type   = "data-security"
      name   = "Organization export default"
      status = "draft"
      rule = {
        export = {
          effect = "allow"
        }
      }
      metadata = {
        policy_coverage_level = "ORG"
        description           = "Allow exports by default for organization policy overrides."
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `data` (Attributes) Data-security policy request data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID used in the API path.

### Optional

- `create_timeout` (String) Positive Go duration for the create request and convergence checks. Defaults to `2m`.
- `delete_timeout` (String) Positive Go duration for the delete request and convergence checks. Defaults to `2m`.
- `update_timeout` (String) Positive Go duration for the update request and convergence checks. Defaults to `2m`.

### Read-Only

- `policy_id` (String) Policy ID returned by the API.

Read-Only:

### Nested Schema for `data.attributes`

Required:

- `metadata` (Attributes) Writable policy metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--attributes--metadata))
- `name` (String) Policy draft name.
- `rule` (Attributes) Policy rules. Only `export` has a verified lifecycle. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--attributes--rule))
- `type` (String) Policy type; must be `data-security`.

Optional:

- `status` (String) Policy status. Only `draft` is managed because publication is a separate bulk operation.

### Nested Schema for `data.attributes.metadata`

Required:

- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `policy_coverage_level` (String) Policy coverage. Only `ORG` is supported by this verified resource.

### Nested Schema for `data.attributes.rule.export`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = atlassian_data_security_policy.example

  identity = {
    organization_id = "your-organization-id"
    policy_id       = "your-policy-id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID.
- `policy_id` (String) Policy ID.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = atlassian_data_security_policy.example
  id = "organization-id,policy-id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import atlassian_data_security_policy.example 'organization-id,policy-id'
```
